destinations.name: Alchi
destinations.tagline: A 1000-year-old Buddhist art gallery hidden in a tiny village — the oldest surviving murals in Ladakh, painted when the Chola dynasty ruled South India.

destinations.name: Drass
destinations.tagline: The second coldest inhabited place on Earth, a war memorial that will make you cry, and -45°C winters.

destinations.name: Hanle
destinations.tagline: Darkest skies in India — a remote observatory village at 4500m where the Milky Way is visible to the naked eye.

destinations.name: Kargil
destinations.tagline: The gateway between Kashmir and Ladakh, a war-scarred town finding peace — and the start of the Zanskar road.

destinations.name: Khardung La
destinations.tagline: 5,359m pass north of Leh — the gateway to Nubra Valley and a rite of passage for motorcyclists.

destinations.name: Lamayuru
destinations.tagline: The moon landscape monastery — Ladakh at its most alien, with a 1000-year-old gompa perched above a crater of eroded clay.

destinations.name: Leh
destinations.tagline: The town where every road trip to Ladakh begins with 2 mandatory days of doing nothing — and somehow those 2 days become the highlight.

destinations.name: Likir
destinations.tagline: A living monastery where monks still debate, pray, and tend gardens — plus a giant golden Maitreya Buddha visible for miles.

destinations.name: Nubra Valley
destinations.tagline: Sand dunes at 3000m with double-hump camels, a monastery watching over the valley, and the last Indian village before Pakistan.

destinations.name: Pangong Tso
destinations.tagline: The most Instagrammed lake in India and the most dangerous for unprepared tourists — 4350m of beauty that punishes anyone who skips acclimatization.

destinations.name: Tso Moriri
destinations.tagline: Pangong's quieter, wilder twin — where Changpa nomads graze pashmina goats and the lake reflects a sky nobody else is looking at.

destinations.name: Turtuk
destinations.tagline: India's last Balti village on the Shyok — opened to visitors in 2010, still feels half-secret.

destinations.name: Umlingla
destinations.tagline: World's highest motorable road at 5883m — the ultimate test of altitude, endurance, and vehicle reliability.

destinations.name: Zanskar Valley
destinations.tagline: India's most inaccessible inhabited valley — where the river freezes into a walkable sheet and monks live in monasteries hanging from cliffs.

destinations.name: Amboli
destinations.tagline: Maharashtra's southernmost hill station — Sahyadri waterfalls, king cobras, and monsoon magic

destinations.name: Bhandardara
destinations.tagline: Arthur Lake, fireflies in May, and Kalsubai — Maharashtra's rooftop

destinations.name: Bhimashankar
destinations.tagline: One of 12 Jyotirlingas — Sahyadri temple, giant Indian squirrel sanctuary, and monsoon treks

destinations.name: Igatpuri
destinations.tagline: Vipassana meditation headquarters, monsoon waterfalls, and Sahyadri treks

destinations.name: Khandala
destinations.tagline: The twin of Lonavala — Bollywood's favourite ghats, Duke's Nose, and the misty Western Ghats

destinations.name: Kolad
destinations.tagline: Maharashtra's Rishikesh — white water rafting on the Kundalika River, 2 hours from Mumbai

destinations.name: Kolhapur
destinations.tagline: Mahalaxmi Temple, kushti wrestling, and the spiciest misal pav you'll ever eat

destinations.name: Lonavala
destinations.tagline: Mumbai-Pune's favourite monsoon escape — fudge, fog, and fort trails

destinations.name: Nashik
destinations.tagline: Wine capital of India — Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga, Godavari ghats, and Sula vineyards

destinations.name: Pune
destinations.tagline: Oxford of the East — Maratha history, misal pav capital, and India's craft beer hub

destinations.name: Raigad Fort
destinations.tagline: Shivaji's capital — the coronation site of the Maratha Empire, now UNESCO World Heritage

destinations.name: Shirdi
destinations.tagline: Sai Baba's holy town — one of India's top 5 pilgrimage destinations, 40,000 visitors daily

destinations.name: Trimbakeshwar
destinations.tagline: Jyotirlinga and Godavari source — where India's second-longest river begins its 1,465km journey

destinations.name: Belur
destinations.tagline: UNESCO Hoysala temple — Chennakesava's soapstone carvings are the most intricate in India

destinations.name: Dharmasthala
destinations.tagline: The temple that feeds 30,000 people free every day — Dharmasthala's annadana tradition

destinations.name: Halebidu
destinations.tagline: UNESCO Hoysala masterpiece — Hoysaleshwara Temple with 240 wall panels of mythological scenes

destinations.name: Jog Falls
destinations.tagline: India's second-highest plunge waterfall — 253 metres of monsoon fury in four cascades

destinations.name: Mysore
destinations.tagline: The city of palaces — Chamundi Hills, silk saris, sandalwood, and India's grandest Dasara festival

destinations.name: Shravanabelagola
destinations.tagline: The 57-foot Bahubali monolith — world's largest free-standing statue, 1,000 years old

destinations.name: Srirangapatna
destinations.tagline: Tipu Sultan's island fortress on the Kaveri — where the Tiger of Mysore made his last stand

destinations.name: Adilabad
destinations.tagline: Kuntala Falls, tiger reserve, and Gond tribal culture — Telangana's wild north

destinations.name: Ananthagiri Hills
destinations.tagline: Hyderabad's nearest hill escape — 79km to misty forests and ancient temples

destinations.name: Kolanupaka
destinations.tagline: 2,000-year-old jade Mahaveer statue — Telangana's hidden Jain treasure

destinations.name: Pillalamarri
destinations.tagline: 800-year-old banyan tree — India's 2nd largest, with Sufi tombs underneath

destinations.name: Pochampally
destinations.tagline: UNESCO-recognized ikat weaving village — India's first GI-tagged handloom

destinations.name: Ramappa Temple
destinations.tagline: UNESCO World Heritage (2021) — the only temple in India named after its sculptor

destinations.name: Chandratal
destinations.tagline: Crescent-shaped lake at 4,300m — reachable only in summer, camped beside on borrowed time.

destinations.name: Keylong
destinations.tagline: Lahaul district HQ — the most important town nobody stops in, gateway to Leh from HP side.

destinations.name: Kinner Kailash
destinations.tagline: A natural Shivalingam rock on a 6,055m peak with a challenging 5-day parikrama.

destinations.name: Manimahesh Kailash
destinations.tagline: An unclimbed sacred peak above Manimahesh Lake, honored by the annual Janmashtami-to-Radha Ashtami yatra.

destinations.name: Shrikhand Mahadev
destinations.tagline: One of India's toughest pilgrim treks: a 5-day ordeal with vertical snow pitches and a 75-foot Shivalingam.

destinations.name: Bangus Valley
destinations.tagline: A permit-required frontier valley near the LoC that rewards the bureaucratic effort with meadows nobody else is standing in.

destinations.name: Gurez Valley
destinations.tagline: The most beautiful valley you've never heard of — because it's on the LoC and was closed to civilians until 2007.

destinations.name: Kishtwar
destinations.tagline: Where the Himalaya gets wild — Kishtwar is the adventure frontier that even Ladakh seekers skip.

destinations.name: Sinthan Top
destinations.tagline: A high pass between Kashmir and Kishtwar where the meadow at the top makes you forget you're on a road.

destinations.name: Tosamaidan
destinations.tagline: Asia's largest meadow was an army artillery range until 2014. The mines are gone. The beauty was always there.

destinations.name: Hemkund Sahib
destinations.tagline: Sikh pilgrimage shrine at 4,633m — a 6km walk up from Ghangaria, beside a glacial lake.

destinations.name: Mount Kailash & Mansarovar
destinations.tagline: The real Mount Kailash (6,638m) and sacred Lake Mansarovar, a 24-day yatra via the Lipulekh Pass.

destinations.name: Valley of Flowers
destinations.tagline: A UNESCO valley that blooms with 500+ wildflower species for exactly 8 weeks a year. Miss the window, miss the point.

destinations.name: Mandu
destinations.tagline: Romantic medieval citadel at 634m — Jahaz Mahal, Rani Roopmati's love story, and 45 sq km of Afghan-Mughal ruins that most of India has forgotten.

destinations.name: Orchha
destinations.tagline: A forgotten Bundela kingdom on the Betwa river — grand cenotaphs and palaces with zero crowds and sunset views that rival any fort in India.

destinations.name: Courtallam (Kutralam)
destinations.tagline: Spa of South India — 9 herb-infused waterfalls with natural healing properties

destinations.name: Hogenakkal Falls
destinations.tagline: India's Niagara — coracle rides through waterfalls and a 2,000-year-old oil massage tradition

destinations.name: Belum Caves
destinations.tagline: India's 2nd longest cave system — 3.2km of stalactites deep underground

destinations.name: Chitrakote Falls
destinations.tagline: India's Niagara, widest waterfall, Bastar tribal region

destinations.name: Spice Plantations (Ponda)
destinations.tagline: Walk through nutmeg, pepper, and vanilla — Goa's spice plantations are edible education

destinations.name: Saputara
destinations.tagline: Gujarat's only hill station in the Western Ghats — tribal culture meets misty forests

destinations.name: Athirapally Falls
destinations.tagline: Niagara of India — India's largest waterfall by volume flow

destinations.name: Raghurajpur
destinations.tagline: India's first Heritage Craft Village — every home is a 1,500-year-old art gallery
